description.en:
The ID of the ASR model. Valid values:

- Generic - Telephony - Mandarin Chinese model ID: 7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac

- Generic - Telephony - Cantonese model ID: 9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77

- Generic - Telephony - Chinese Dialects model ID: 3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b

description.zh:
ASR状态。取值：

- **false**：关闭（默认值）
- **true**：开启
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR). Valid values:

- **false** (default): Disables ASR.

- **true**: Enables ASR.

description.zh:
重置绑定关系中的号码显示逻辑。固定取值：**1**（主被叫显示中间号码X）。

> 由于运营商监管限制，呼叫时显示真实号码的设置不生效。
description.en:
Sets the caller ID display logic for the binding. The value must be **1**, which indicates that the privacy number (Phone number X) is displayed to both the caller and the callee.

> Due to carrier-side regulatory restrictions, settings that display real numbers are not supported.

description.zh:
单通呼叫限制的状态。取值：

- **CONTROL_AX_DISABLE**：A号码无法呼叫X号码。
- **CONTROL_BX_DISABLE**：B号码无法呼叫X号码。
description.en:
The call restriction policy. Valid values:

- **CONTROL\_AX\_DISABLE**: Disables calls from Phone number A to Phone number X.

- **CONTROL\_BX\_DISABLE**: Disables calls from Phone number B to Phone number X.

description.zh:
指定城市进行X号码的选号。

> - 如果当前号码池中没有该城市的可用号码，或未指定此参数，将从当前号码池中随机分配一个其他城市的号码作为X号码。
> - 如果**X号码分配模式**配置为**严格匹配模式**，当符合条件的号码不存在时，系统会提示分配错误。
description.en:
The city from which to select Phone number X.

> - If no numbers are available in the specified city or if you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly assigns a number from another city in the current number pool.
>
> - If **Number X Allocation Mode** is set to **Strict Match Mode**, the system returns an allocation error if it cannot find an eligible number.

description.zh:
绑定关系的过期时间，单位：秒。

> 必须晚于当前时间60秒以上。
description.en:
The expiration time of the binding. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

> The expiration time must be at least 60 seconds in the future.

description.zh:
是否需要针对该绑定关系产生的所有通话录制通话录音。取值：

- **true**：录音。
- **false**：不录音（默认值）。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable call recording for this binding. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables call recording.

- **false** (default): Disables call recording.

description.zh:
号码类型。

> 适用于原阿里大于客户，阿里云用户可忽略。
description.en:
The number type.

> This parameter applies to legacy Alibaba Dayu customers. Current Alibaba Cloud users can ignore this parameter.

description.zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。
description.en: An external extension field that is included in the call detail record (CDR) callback.

description.zh:
AXN隐私号的A号码。
A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
description.en: Phone number A for the AXN binding. This can be a mobile phone number or a fixed-line phone. For a fixed-line phone, you must include the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the phone number.

description.zh:
AXN隐私号的B号码。

B号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
> - A号码拨打X号码时，默认会转接到B号码，如B号码未设置，则无法接通。
> - A号码拨打X号码时，**A号码回拨模式**为**默认模式**时，才会转接到B号码，若不是**默认模式**，则无法接通。
> - 如需修改**A号码回拨模式**，在[号码池管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1)>筛选**AXN隐私号**>**号池管理**>**A号码回拨模式**>**调整配置**修改。
> - 如需更新B号码，请调用[UpdateSubscription](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i11)接口更新。
description.en:
Phone number B for the AXN binding.

This can be a mobile phone number or a fixed-line phone. For a fixed-line phone, you must include the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the phone number.

> - By default, calls from Phone number A to Phone number X are routed to Phone number B. If you do not specify Phone number B, the call fails to connect.
>
> - A call from Phone number A to Phone number X is routed to Phone number B only if **Callback Mode for Number A** is set to **Default mode**. Otherwise, the call fails to connect.
>
> - To change the **Callback Mode for Number A**, go to the [Number Pool Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1) page, filter for **AXN Privacy Number**, and then choose **Pool Management** > **Callback Mode for Number A** > **Adjust Configuration**.
>
> - To update Phone number B, call the [UpdateSubscription](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i11) API.

description.zh:
AXN隐私号的X号码。

X号码是您在控制台已[购买的隐私号](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)。

> 如果未指定X号码时，将根据参数ExpectCity从指定号码池中随机指定一个号码作为X号码。
description.en:
Phone number X, the privacy number for the AXN binding.

Phone number X must be one of your [Purchased Privacy Numbers](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) in the console.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly assigns a number from the number pool as Phone number X. The selection is based on the ExpectCity parameter.

description.zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，[号码池管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)页面获取**号码池Key**。
description.en:
The key of the Number Pool.

You can get the **Pool Key** from the [Number Pool Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) page.

description.zh:
设置AXN隐私号在号码绑定后，拨打X号码的企业彩铃。

此参数请填写**铃音字段**和**彩铃编码**。

**铃音字段**取值：
- AXN中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（有回拨号码）：AXNRing_AB
- AXN中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（无回拨号码）：AXNRing_A
- AXN中，N侧号码打X接通前的铃音设置：AXNRing_N
- AXN中，A号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_A_PICKUP
- AXN中，N号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_N_PICKUP

**彩铃编码**：

在号码隐私保护控制台[企业彩铃管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1)页面获取企业彩铃编码。

**填写示例**：

如设置A号码拨打X接通前的铃音（无回拨号码），填写："AXNRing_A": "1000****1"。

> 企业彩铃优先使用绑定级别设置的彩铃，如果未设置或设置未生效，则会使用号码池级别的彩铃音。
description.en:
Configures the enterprise ring-back tone for calls to Phone number X.

This parameter requires a **ringtone field** and a **ring-back tone code**.

Valid values for the **ringtone field**:

- The ring-back tone that plays before a call from Phone number A to Phone number X connects (with callback number): AXNRing\_AB

- The ring-back tone that plays before a call from Phone number A to Phone number X connects (without callback number): AXNRing\_A

- The ring-back tone that plays before a call from Phone number N to Phone number X connects: AXNRing\_N

- The in-call tone that plays after a call from Phone number A to Phone number X connects: AXNRing\_A\_PICKUP

- The in-call tone that plays after a call from Phone number N to Phone number X connects: AXNRing\_N\_PICKUP

**Ring-back tone code**:

You can get the enterprise ring-back tone code from the [Enterprise CRBT Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1) page.

**Example format**:

To set the ring-back tone for calls from Phone number A to Phone number X (without a callback number), use the following format: "AXNRing\_A":"1000\*\*\*\*1".

> The enterprise ring-back tone set at the binding level takes precedence. If a tone is not set at the binding level or the setting is invalid, the system uses the tone set at the number pool level.

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已在控制台[购买隐私号](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy)。

- 您可以使用此接口给AXN隐私号绑定号码，也可以在控制台[号码管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.64e649bbTzmb6j&resType=1&billId=FC100000165392498)页面给AXN隐私号绑定A、B号码。

- AXN隐私号，绑定号码前建议您先明确业务场景中的A角色。例如：在二手车信息发布场景中，A是房东或经纪人联系方式。

### QPS 限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为 5000 次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Before calling this API, ensure you have [purchased privacy numbers](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy) in the Console.

- Use this API to bind a number to an AXN privacy number. Alternatively, you can manage number bindings on the [Number Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.64e649bbTzmb6j\&resType=1\&billId=FC100000165392498) page in the Console.

- Before you create an AXN binding, clearly define the role of A in your use case. For example, in a used car classifieds scenario, A is the seller's or agent's contact number.

### Rate limit

This API has a rate limit of 5,000 requests per second (RPS) per user. The system throttles API calls that exceed this limit, which can impact your application's performance. To avoid throttling, manage your call frequency.
